edge_frame_gate_activation.gate_count: lmax * channels invariant scalars, one per non-scalar degree and channel
edge_frame_gate_activation.input: uniform l=0..lmax SO(3) coefficients in one m-primary edge frame
edge_frame_gate_activation.transformation: invariant gates scale fixed-degree edge-frame coefficients and preserve the represented SO(3) type

grid_invariant_product.certification: finite-grid empirical equivariance, not analytic exactness
grid_invariant_product.input: finite S2 samples [carrier, grid_point, channel] and invariant [carrier, channel] gates
grid_invariant_product.runtime_broadcast: invariant feature axes are flattened and singleton sampling axes are inserted explicitly

shared_final_norm.statement: one SO(3)-equivariant final normalization result is aliased to both task heads
